run_gpe_gpi_experiment: run GPE/GPI experiment on scavenger task with a pre-trained keyboard model and regressed weights
load_keyboard_model: load a pre-trained keyboard model from a TensorFlow Hub path using SmartModuleImport
create_scavenger_environment: create a scavenger environment with logging wrapped by EnvironmentWithLogging and EnvironmentWithKeyboardDirect
create_regressed_agent: create a regressed agent with Adam optimizer and random initialization weights for the keyboard
run_experiment_and_write_results: run the experiment for a given number of episodes and write EMA returns to an output file
